title: City of Stars
credit: Transcribed from the score in your Drive ("my city.pdf", arr. The Piano Keys)
_notation: Per hand, one string per bar. Tokens: pitch (G4, Bb3, C#5), chord [G4 Bb4 D5], rest r. Suffix :n = length in eighths (default 1; fractions like 2/3 allowed). Prefix ~ = tied from the previous token of the same pitch (no new attack). Prefix / = rolled chord. Every bar must sum to 8 eighths.

sections.name: Intro
sections.hint: Left hand alone: the G minor vamp that runs under the whole song. Get the shuffle feel in the fingers before anything else.
sections.coach: Four bars of the G minor vamp — the ground the whole song stands on.

sections.name: Theme
sections.hint: The melody enters. Right hand is a single line; left hand keeps the vamp and moves to C7 and Dm.

sections.name: Theme, second time
sections.hint: Same tune, but the harmony turns: F, a passing A diminished, G minor, and the rolled A7 chord that sets up the return.

sections.name: Chords under the theme
sections.hint: The melody now carries triads on the offbeats. Keep the top note singing; the lower notes are just weight.

sections.name: Turn
sections.hint: Five bars of transition. Bar 32 has the high bell (C6 A6); bar 34 has the fast run, which you can play free of the click.

sections.name: Bridge
sections.hint: Octaves in the left hand, block chords in the right. This is a different technique from the rest of the song: think drums, not arpeggios.

sections.name: Bridge, high
sections.hint: The same bridge an octave up in the right hand, ending on the fermata chord in bar 48.

sections.name: Reprise and ending
sections.hint: The theme returns, then the rolled A7 and the final D minor chord.
